entries.consumer: sdd-bootstrap-interviewer shared question bank (requirements, UX, contracts, workflow, backend/testing, infrastructure, security)
entries.scope: Full-Profile Layer Interview section of sdd-bootstrap-interviewer/SKILL.md: the shared interview questions themselves.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 1: shared questions remain in the common interview; target-specific follow-up becomes conditional through resolved Facets rather than replacing the interviewer.

entries.consumer: sdd-bootstrap-interviewer Phase 1 required seven-layer document set (Required Outputs section)
entries.scope: The mandatory seven Markdown layer files generated under specs/<feature>/ for the full profile.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 2: always generate and retain all seven legacy layer documents in legacy and facet-hybrid paths, including non-UI targets; express target applicability separately in the Facet manifest/selection rather than omitting a document.

entries.scope: The Layer Specifications table in the design.md template that always lists the four legacy layer rows.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 2 / design.md consumer row 2: treat these rows as the legacy representation; retain all seven legacy layer documents in facet-hybrid; a facet-native path that omits non-applicable documents requires a separately approved, versioned migration.

entries.consumer: check-contract.py risk-tier and baseline check id constants (RISK_TIERS / BASELINE_IDS)
entries.scope: The hardcoded RISK_TIERS mapping and BASELINE_IDS set that define required checks per risk tier.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 3: Core owns risk and evidence semantics; target Capability supplies required/conditional verification obligations through the protected Registry/resolver contract; checks must not become a user-editable escape hatch.

entries.consumer: design-sync-loop SKILL.md DesignSync/claude.ai/design capability detection and mockup upload steps
entries.scope: The DesignSync tool probe and the concrete external-tool upload mechanics of the design iteration loop.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 5: keep generic user-centered design requirements and local visual-reference support in bootstrap; put concrete external-tool operations behind an optional UI design provider/capability boundary while preserving consent and manual fallback semantics.

entries.consumer: architecture-review-checklist.md OpenAPI/JSON Schema endpoint contract check
entries.scope: The Contract Alignment checklist item requiring OpenAPI or JSON Schema contracts for every new or changed endpoint.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 6: keep contract correctness, pre/postconditions, errors, and compatibility as shared principles; choose OpenAPI, JSON Schema, or a target-appropriate contract through the Capability, avoiding a mandatory HTTP endpoint schema for non-HTTP designs.

entries.consumer: mcp/ci-mcp read-only GitHub Actions server and client
entries.scope: The ci-mcp package boundary: its tool registrations (server.ts) and its GET-only GitHub API client (github-client.ts).
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 7: the existing package boundary is adequate; future CI/VCS integrations stay behind provider adapters and must not add GitHub REST assumptions to common policy.

source.keyword: GET request against the GitHub Actions REST API

entries.consumer: Provider resource schemas, state authority, credentials, and commands (ADR-0018 Provider Bindings)
entries.scope: Provider Binding identity, state authority, and credential references defined by ADR-0018.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 8: belongs to Provider Bindings/Provider Adapters and later provider-specific work, not this common Core slice.

entries.consumer: Artifact and promotion gate stages (ADR-0017 reserved stages)
entries.scope: The artifact and promotion gate stages reserved by ADR-0017; this slice uses implementation-stage verification only.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 9: reserved by ADR-0017; this scope uses implementation-stage verification only.

entries.consumer: Host-specific launch syntax and invocation adapters (sdd-bootstrap-interviewer Invocation section)
entries.scope: The Codex text-invocation block versus the Claude Code slash-command entry point for the same skill.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 10: continue using host-specific packaging/adapters; common workflow meanings and approval rules remain shared.

entries.consumer: Facet-native output and distribution/package decomposition (ADR-0016 facet-native layout)
entries.scope: The facet-native artifact_layout value defined by ADR-0016 as the future, not-yet-adopted form.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 11: requires migration evidence and separate approval; not needed to establish logical ownership boundaries in this slice.

entries.consumer: check-contract.py compile/build/lint waiver logic for non-code stacks (COMPILE_CHECKS / NONCODE_STACKS / compile_waivable)
entries.scope: The stack-descriptor constants and the compile_waivable branch of _pass4_risk_tier that waives compile-oriented checks only for non-code stacks.
entries.rationale: requirements.md REQ-001 row 4: resolve appropriate verification kinds per target; distinguish not-applicable from not-run/unknown; existing fixed checks remain in legacy behavior until a versioned migration.
